actions.reason: K4_C0001 has a coherent candidate-specific identity in two independent modalities (broad OXPHOS/immune/interferon down-regulation; PBRM1/VHL enrichment with BAP1 depletion surviving full-family correction), and its set-specific confounder screen shows no factor surviving correction, so no measured technical alternative is established for this set. Its internal structure is single-cluster dominated with near-zero internal silhouettes, so no split is warranted. Pair reviews with K4_C0002 and K4_C0004 show weak boundaries and single-cluster-dominated unions, which is compatible with but not sufficient for merge; no exact-pair structural report supports removing the boundary, so the current unit is retained.

K4_C0002 has a coherent candidate-specific identity in two independent modalities (broad OXPHOS/protein-secretion/fatty-acid/mTORC1 up-regulation; marked VHL and PBRM1 depletion with VHL surviving full-family correction). Although its set-specific confounder screen shows significant site/acquisition associations, these are associations rather than proof of artifact, and the candidate retains a distinct biological identity; internal structure is single-cluster dominated with near-zero internal silhouettes, so no split is warranted. Pair reviews with K4_C0001 and K4_C0003 show weak boundaries and single-cluster-dominated unions, compatible with but not sufficient for merge, and no exact-pair structural report supports removing the boundary, so the current unit is retained.

K4_C0003 has a coherent candidate-specific identity in two independent modalities (strong immune/interferon up-regulation with metabolic down-regulation; strong BAP1 enrichment surviving both driver-panel and full-family correction). Its set-specific confounder screen shows a significant site association, but this is an association rather than proof of artifact and the candidate retains a distinct biological identity; internal structure is single-cluster dominated with near-zero internal silhouettes, so no split is warranted. Pair reviews with K4_C0002 and K4_C0004 show weak boundaries and single-cluster-dominated unions, compatible with but not sufficient for merge, and no exact-pair structural report supports removing the boundary, so the current unit is retained.

K4_C0004 has a coherent candidate-specific identity in two independent modalities (UV-response-DN/hedgehog/mitotic-spindle/EMT/TGF-beta up-regulation with OXPHOS down-regulation; VHL enrichment and PBRM1 depletion surviving driver-panel FDR), and its set-specific confounder screen shows no factor surviving correction, so no measured technical alternative is established for this set. Its internal structure is single-cluster dominated with a near-zero internal silhouette, so no split is warranted. Pair reviews with K4_C0003 and K4_C0001 show weak boundaries and single-cluster-dominated unions, compatible with but not sufficient for merge, and no exact-pair structural report supports removing the boundary, so the current unit is retained.
